newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi shares spend week in a narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Saudi shares spend week in a narrow range.

text.p: Shares on Saudi Arabia's stock market traded in a narrow range last week in lower volume dealings, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Saturday.
The all-share index closed on Thursday at 159.21 points from 159.08 a week earlier.
Turnover ebbed, falling to some 2.54 million shares worth 534.84 million riyals from 3.22 million shares worth some 786 million riyals the week before.

Services sector shares continued to dominate trade, accounting for over 30 percent of volume. Cement and banking stocks followed, with 20 percent each. Agriculture stocks made up 16 percent and industrial stocks 10 percent.
Of the 57 shares traded in the week, 23 rose, 20 fell and 14 were unchanged.
After losing eight percent the week before, Amiantit raced ahead 15.4 percent to 120 riyals. SARCO rose 6.3 to 337 riyals and Thimar was almost five percent stronger at 66 riyals.
Yanbu Cement was three percent firmer at 231 riyals.
GACO reversed recent gains, sliding eight percent to 23 riyals from 25. SRECO fell almost seven percent to 126 riyals and Tabuk Electricity was five riyals weaker at 90 riyals.
Saudi Hollandi Bank lost 3.3 percent to 464 riyals.
